clue.text: Adventurous deer running between wood and lake in curving movement

indicators.note: 'in' places the wood-deer-lake run inside the word for the curving movement

parts.note: a swing is a curving movement, like a pendulum's

indicators.note: 'running between' sets the deer's letters between those for wood and lake

parts.note: ash is a kind of wood
L is the standard abbreviation for lake on maps
a buck is a male deer

explanation.surface: A deer dashes between a wood and a lake, moving in an adventurous arc.
explanation.walkthrough: BUCK goes between ASH and L ('running between'), and that run sits 'in' SWING, splitting it SW...ING.
explanation.definitionFit: A swashbuckling hero is daring and dashing, like a swordfighting pirate in a film.

clue.text: Extensive ridge filled with burrows

indicators.note: 'filled with' means the ridge word has the burrows word placed inside it

parts.note: a wale is a raised ridge, as on corduroy or skin
holes are burrows dug by animals

explanation.surface: A long ridge is riddled with animal burrows over a wide area.
explanation.definitionFit: Wholesale used as an adjective means on a large scale, sweeping and indiscriminate.

clue.text: Vegetables after sun's risen becoming shiny

indicators.note: in a down entry, 'risen' sends the letter for sun upwards to the top of the word

parts.note: leeks are vegetables
S is the abbreviation for sun

explanation.surface: Vegetables grown in the sunshine come up glossy.
explanation.walkthrough: The S at the end of LEEKS 'has risen' to the top of this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Something sleek has a smooth glossy surface, like well-groomed fur.

clue.text: Language at start of argument divides family

indicators.note: 'divides' means the at-plus-letter run splits the family word in two

parts.note: a clan is an extended family

indicators.note: 'start of' takes the first letter of argument

explanation.surface: A family row begins over a disputed point and splits the household.
explanation.walkthrough: AT plus A (the start of 'argument') goes inside CLAN after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Catalan is the Romance tongue spoken in Catalonia, around Barcelona.

clue.text: Essential element of bold lie unravelled

indicators.note: 'unravelled' signals that the letters of the phrase are untangled and rearranged

explanation.surface: A brazen untruth comes apart, revealing what matters at its heart.
explanation.definitionFit: Lifeblood is figuratively the vital force that keeps something going.

clue.text: Low number put on broadcast in which there's depth

indicators.note: 'in which there's' means the depth letter is placed inside the broadcast word

parts.note: to air something is to broadcast it

explanation.surface: A figure placed on a programme that explores the depths.
explanation.walkthrough: N is 'put on' (placed before) AIR, which holds D.
explanation.definitionFit: The nadir is the lowest point, as in the low of a career.

clue.text: Friend endlessly upset about article topped by engineer with meagre building material

indicators.note: in a down entry 'topped by' puts the engineer and meagre words above the friend part

parts.note: James Watt was the Scottish engineer of steam-engine fame
lean means meagre or scanty

indicators.note: 'about' means the reversed friend letters go round the article
in a down clue 'upset' turns the trimmed friend word upside down, reading it backwards
'endlessly' drops the last letter of the friend word

parts.note: buddy is an informal word for a friend
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A clumsy friend fumbles a piece about cheap building stuff and an engineer.
explanation.walkthrough: BUDDY 'endlessly' is BUDD; 'upset' gives DDUB, which goes 'about' A to make DDAUB, 'topped by' WATT and LEAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Wattle and daub is woven twigs plastered with mud or clay, an old method of making walls.

clue.text: Book, fantastic seller, burying more elevated, dry, aesthetic works

indicators.note: 'burying' means the reshuffled seller letters enclose the next two parts
'fantastic' tells us the letters of seller are rearranged wildly
in a down entry 'elevated' raises the word for more so it reads upwards

parts.note: else means more or additional, as in 'anything else'
TT, teetotal, means dry, not drinking alcohol

explanation.surface: A fantastic bestseller book conceals loftier and drier artistic works.
explanation.walkthrough: ELSE is 'elevated' to ESLE; with TT it is buried in ELLRES, the 'fantastic' rearrangement of SELLER, after B.
explanation.definitionFit: Belles-lettres is literature valued for style and beauty rather than information.

clue.text: Satisfaction at having sound crew aboard

indicators.note: 'aboard' puts the sound and crew words inside the word at, like passengers in a vessel

parts.note: a tone is a musical sound
men can mean a crew or workforce

explanation.surface: A ship's officer is pleased to have a solid crew on board.
explanation.walkthrough: TONE and MEN go 'aboard' AT, splitting it A...T.
explanation.definitionFit: Atonement, in the old sense, is making amends or reparation for a wrong done.

clue.text: Move in which bishop's replaced by fellow making attempt to misrepresent issue

indicators.note: 'replaced by' swaps the bishop letter for the fellow letter in the move word

parts.note: to budge is to move slightly
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
F is the abbreviation for fellow, as in FRS

explanation.surface: In a chess move a bishop gives way to another piece, muddling the position.
explanation.definitionFit: To fudge an issue is to evade or blur it deliberately.

clue.text: Time, lacking power, to make fine adjustment

parts.note: weak means lacking power or strength

explanation.surface: With time running out and no energy left, a mechanic makes a small tweak.
explanation.definitionFit: To tweak is to adjust something slightly to improve it.

clue.text: Draft of proposed law, one rejected by earl sadly devoid of tolerance

indicators.note: 'rejected' sends the law draft and the one back the way they came, read in reverse

parts.note: a bill is a draft law put before parliament
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: 'sadly' signals that the letters of earl are disturbed and rearranged

explanation.surface: Parliament throws out a bill, and a sad earl is left looking narrow-minded.
explanation.walkthrough: BILL and I are 'rejected' (reversed) to ILLIB, followed by ERAL, the letters of EARL rearranged 'sadly'.
explanation.definitionFit: An illiberal person is narrow-minded and opposed to free thought.

clue.text: Cut back tree without a lesson

indicators.note: 'back' reverses the word for a cutting tool so it reads backwards

parts.note: an axe is a tool used to cut wood, here standing for cut

indicators.note: 'without' means the letter a is taken out of the tree

parts.note: a maple is a tree
taken as written, the letter removed

explanation.surface: A lesson in pruning: cut back the tree.
explanation.walkthrough: AXE turned 'back' gives EXA; MAPLE 'without' A gives MPLE.
explanation.definitionFit: An example is a case that serves as a warning or instruction, as in 'let that be a lesson'.

clue.text: Love new style in a fabric

indicators.note: 'in' places the love-plus-reshuffled-style letters inside the word for a

parts.note: per means a, as in 'fifty miles per hour' for 'fifty miles an hour'
O is love, a zero score in tennis

indicators.note: 'new' signals a new arrangement of the letters of style

explanation.surface: A designer loves the new look in a particular cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: O plus LYEST (STYLE rearranged, 'new') goes 'in' PER.
explanation.definitionFit: Polyester is a synthetic fibre used to make cloth.

clue.text: People lacking sense to have pasta?

definitions.meaning: a noodle is an old informal word for a silly person
long strands of pasta are another sense of the plural word

explanation.surface: Do fools eat spaghetti?
explanation.definitionFit: Noodle is slang for a fool, and noodles are also thin strips of dough.

clue.text: Fine sheep climbing in group hurry up

indicators.note: 'in' places the fine and climbing-sheep letters inside the group word

parts.note: a lot is a group or batch
OK means fine

indicators.note: in a down entry 'climbing' makes the sheep word read upwards

parts.note: rams are male sheep

explanation.surface: A shepherd urges a fine flock to climb faster.
explanation.walkthrough: OK plus SMAR (RAMS reversed by 'climbing') goes 'in' LOT.
explanation.definitionFit: Look sharp is an idiom telling someone to move quickly.

clue.text: Goads mostly not required

indicators.note: 'mostly' means most of the word is used, dropping its final letter

parts.note: needless means not required

explanation.surface: Provocations are generally uncalled for.
explanation.definitionFit: To needle someone is to provoke or irritate them persistently, so goads is a synonym.

clue.text: Move before resistance and raise support

parts.note: to stir is to move
R is the symbol for electrical resistance
to up something is to raise it, as in upping a price

explanation.surface: Get going before the opposition grows, and lift your backing.
explanation.definitionFit: A stirrup is the loop that supports a rider's foot.

clue.text: Aquatic creature with power caught by party in story

indicators.note: 'in' places the party-holding-power letters inside the story word

parts.note: a tale is a story

indicators.note: 'caught by' means the power letter is held inside the party word

parts.note: a do is a party

explanation.surface: A fairy tale in which a pond creature with strength is captured at a party.
explanation.walkthrough: P is 'caught by' DO to make DPO, which goes 'in' TALE.
explanation.definitionFit: A tadpole is the larva of a frog or toad, living in water.

clue.text: Fish around Iceland, island nation

indicators.note: 'around' means the fish word goes round the Iceland and island letters

parts.note: tuna is a fish
IS is the international code for Iceland

explanation.surface: Fishing fleets circle Iceland and an island nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Tunisia is a country in North Africa.

clue.text: Exhaustion caused by pressure during removal

indicators.note: 'during' puts the pressure letter inside the removal word

parts.note: a deletion is a removal
P is the symbol for pressure

explanation.surface: Fatigue brought on by stress while something is taken away.
explanation.definitionFit: Depletion is the using up of a supply, leaving it exhausted.

clue.text: Pseud creating problem

definitions.meaning: a pretentious person who strikes attitudes to impress
a puzzling question or tricky dilemma

explanation.definitionFit: A poser is both someone who poses for effect and a baffling question.

clue.text: Assume perch will follow river

indicators.note: 'will follow' places the perch word after the river word

parts.note: the Po is a river in northern Italy
to sit is to perch

explanation.surface: An angler supposes a perch will come along after the river.
explanation.definitionFit: To posit is to put forward as a premise, to suppose.

clue.text: Bottle mate found with greeting inside

indicators.note: 'inside' puts the greeting word within the mate word

parts.note: pal means mate or friend
hi is a greeting

explanation.surface: A friend arrives with a bottle and a hello.
explanation.definitionFit: A phial is a small glass vial for liquid.

clue.text: Ruffled in debate, spun round

indicators.note: 'round' means those letters are turned around and read backwards
'in' says the letters are found within the words debate, spun

explanation.surface: Ruffled during a debate, a politician turned around.
explanation.definitionFit: Upset means disturbed or agitated, as ruffled feelings are.

clue.text: Banish revolutionary understood to be engaged in subterfuge

indicators.note: 'engaged in' puts the reversed understood word inside the subterfuge word

parts.note: a ruse is a subterfuge or trick

indicators.note: 'revolutionary' turns the understood word around to read backwards

parts.note: tacit means understood without being stated

explanation.surface: A rebel caught up in a plot is sent into exile.
explanation.walkthrough: TACIT reversed ('revolutionary') is TICAT, placed in RUSE as RUS...E.
explanation.definitionFit: To rusticate is to send away, especially to suspend a student from a British university.

clue.text: Artist, old man, carrying on playing harp with superior group

indicators.note: 'carrying' means the old man word holds the next letters inside it

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father, an old man
re means on or concerning

indicators.note: 'playing' signals the letters of harp are rearranged

parts.note: an elite is a superior group

explanation.surface: An elderly man keeps playing the harp with a top ensemble.
explanation.walkthrough: PA 'carrying' RE and RAPH (HARP rearranged by 'playing') gives PRERAPHA; add ELITE.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pre-Raphaelite Brotherhood were Victorian painters, so one member is an artist.
